authority.statement: The notice and locator grant no permission or authority.

boundaries: Normal lifecycle reconciliation is deferred, not waived; this notice is communication evidence and grants no continuation or mutation authority.
Do not infer Task Session admission, profile or ontology admission, promotion, release, deployment, production readiness, or protected-effect permission from candidate-local validation.
Do not add the legacy v1 adapter to WP-ORODI-PROTOTYPE-002; it remains a separately scoped and separately authorized future decision.

Do not contact live systems, install dependencies, use credentials, run load or fault injection, plan or apply infrastructure, shift traffic, deploy, roll back, commit, push, or use an external transport.
Preserve private DomainSpec evidence inside the private repository scope and do not copy it into public Arcanum sources.
key_points: WP-ORODI-PROTOTYPE-002 fixes a six-control denominator: C01, C05, C11, C12, C14, and C15 are derived from the binding, observations, and evaluation time, then compared with supplied state claims.

The aggregate must reject structurally invalid inputs, any non-passed derived state, and every supplied foundational state that diverges from the derived state; supplied claims cannot influence derivation.
C15 fails broken accounting equations, is inconclusive only for non-zero partial_success, and passes fully accounted pending work.

The current authorization covers repository-local contracts, evaluators, fixtures, tests, CLI validation, and candidate evidence only; normal Invoke readiness and Task Session admission are not claimed.

The Work Pack excludes the legacy v1 adapter, live infrastructure, load execution, canary, deployment, rollback, ontology/profile admission, promotion, release, Git publication, and external delivery.
